@@U02320@@
in groups and pairs, fondly mingling, groups forming and groups dissolving, in and out, no fear of propriety. The world with its untold fund of follies remains unchanged: one great, grand Fool!

@@U02322@@
(Singing to mandolins.)

@@U02323@@
Drawn here by your courtly splendor Decked out in all our best are we, Maids of Florence, come to render Tribute to your courtesy. In our curly nut-brown hair We have woven bright spring flowers, Silken threads, and streamers fair, As if plucked from nature’s bowers. We truly hope to win your praises For our very special art; Our flowers bloom all year in glazes, Artificial and very smart. Scraps of every color mingle, Ordered to content your taste; You may scoff at them in single, But not en masse in order placed. Charming are we to the sight, Darlings to the eye and heart, For womans nature is bound tight To the very soul of art.

@@U02325@@
Lovely ladies, show us now the brimming baskets you bear on your heads, and your bulging armloads of colorful flowers.
translation:
@@U02320@@
成群成对，亲切地交往，成群结队，进进出出，无惧礼节。这个充满了无数愚蠢行为的世界仍然没有改变：一个伟大的、伟大的愚人！

@@U02322@@
（对着曼陀林唱歌。）

@@U02323@@
被您的宫廷辉煌吸引到这里，我们，佛罗伦萨的少女们，打扮得漂漂亮亮，前来向您致敬。在我们坚果棕色的卷发中，我们编织了明亮的春天花朵、丝线和美丽的飘带，仿佛从大自然的凉亭里采摘下来。我们真诚地希望我们独特的艺术能够赢得您的称赞；我们的花一年四季都在釉料中绽放，人造且非常聪明。各种颜色的碎片混合在一起，按您的口味排序；你可以嘲笑它们单个，但不能按顺序排列在一起。我们对视觉充满魅力，对眼睛和心灵来说是宠儿，因为女人的天性与艺术的灵魂紧密相连。

@@U02325@@
可爱的女士们，现在让我们看看你们头上顶着满满的篮子，还有你们鼓鼓囊囊的五颜六色的鲜花。
